notes: ["Intended bound (fn-tariff-zar-reply-within): for every arm of fn-zar-command, (fn-tariff-effects-octets (fn-post-result-effects (fn-zar-command session archive index args fn-arena))) <= a figure stated from the stored payload length, i.e. :syntax arm <= *fn-nntp-max-response-octets*; :stored arm (fn-nntp-multi-octets initial (fn-zdn-body-lines body)) <= (len initial)+2 + stuffed length of the compressed body + 3, where dot-stuffing at most doubles... each body line by one octet (so <= 2*(len body)+ lines + 5 with the charge being the article-row charge for the compressed length); fallback arm = ARTICLE tariff (PGO-TARIFF-ARTICLE-REPLY-WITHIN-TARIFF). title: XFN-ZARTICLE tariff bound is owed: fn-zar-command's reply octets within a declared extension-family figure
